description: Committee recommends $2.0 million budget increase for Willows Sanitary Trunk.
Funds from Trunk Sewer and Wastewater Treatment Capital Reserves.
Enables Willows development, addresses pipe deficiencies and Stonebridge capacity.

chips.text: Staff explained pipe issues were due to assumptions at 9-meter depth.
No mill rate impact; costs recovered from development levies.
Exemption to policy C03-036 for 15% project contingency.

description: Identifies 22nd Street, 8th Street, Woodlawn as top priorities.
Prioritization uses market demand, infrastructure, and equity criteria.

chips.text: Councillor Parker questioned Preston's lower ranking; staff cited equity and connectivity.
Equity lens added to evaluation criteria for corridor plan prioritization.
Funding for physical infrastructure in corridor plans remains unconfirmed.
Public survey received 340 responses on importance of plan areas.
Prioritization considers areas with higher social, economic, material, and housing needs.
Staff committed to providing detailed scoring for each evaluation category.

description: Refer Marr Residence Board's Terms of Reference to administration.
Forward Marr Residence Board's meeting procedures to Council.
Council forwards Heritage Society 50th Anniversary information to committee.
Acknowledged the Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee's 2025 Annual Report.
Development Appeals Board appeals rose 50% in 2025.
Appeal fee increased from $52 to $300 this year.

chips.text: Mayor Block questioned the significant increase in development appeals.
Homeowners seeking larger garages or downtown parking variances.
Will the significant increase in appeals continue in future years?
Public desires for larger garages conflict with current bylaws.
